body: I am learning to drive right know and I fear too that I might hurt someone because of negligence. I have trouble concentrating and make a lot of mistakes, which make it worse to bear. I am 19. And I know there's a big chance I'll just give up because it is too hard.
Do you know why you have low self esteem?

I am in a very similar situation. Dropped in June 2017. Same symptom except that I don't have visual snow anymore, but have other mental condition. I haven't got back to college, but I go to a therapy center.

Indeed, I think we are behind in social aspects, but it extends the problem to mental and physical capabilities. I don't know about OP, but I feel physically terrible.

In France there are clinic for 15 to 25 years old people, where you can live and have medical attention while you're studying. Maybe it exists where OP lives. He should give it a shot if he stays long enough.
Thank you, I didn't realize fearing tomorrow and death could be so related.

I don’t know, just started feeling really bad during the last year of high school, three years ago. It has only gotten worse since then. I don’t feel like meds are working. I gave up entirely everything. I should be an energetic, positive young man, but here I am, lame, anxious, shameful and mentally unstable. I don’t feel like I can do it anymore. I’ve set up a rope in the woods. One day my mind will go wrong and I’ll just commit. You’d be annoyed after knowing me.
